Bài #8 SENTENCE ORDERING MULTIPLE CHOICE 08_sentence_ordering.json

Put the sentences in the correct order

Read the sentences and choose the correct order to form a logical paragraph or conversation.

Câu 1
  1. a. Elena: 'That remarkable victory certainly explains why his people celebrated him as a hero.'
  2. b. Marcus: 'I watched a fascinating documentary about an ancient military genius last night.'
  3. c. Elena: 'What made his wartime strategies so impressive to modern historians?'
  4. d. Marcus: 'He changed his battle tactics unexpectedly and forced the invading army to surrender.'
Câu 2
  1. a. Sara: 'Let's meet at the train station at eight o'clock so we can arrive before the crowds.'
  2. b. Tom: 'That sounds exciting since I really want to examine the original lunar flight modules.'
  3. c. Tom: 'Are we still visiting the aviation museum for our history assignment this Saturday?'
  4. d. Sara: 'Yes, because the main exhibition features cutting-edge technology developed during the space race.'
Câu 3
  1. a. Through intense determination and patient training, the young boy gradually built up his stamina.
  2. b. Ten years later, he crossed the finish line of the national marathon to the cheers of thousands.
  3. c. His parents encouraged him to take daily walks in the countryside to strengthen his breathing.
  4. d. When Julian was diagnosed with a severe respiratory condition as a child, doctors doubted he could ever run.
Câu 4
  1. a. A small team of independent animators began sketching storyboard concepts in an abandoned warehouse.
  2. b. The touching story went on to become an unexpected global blockbuster that captivated audiences worldwide.
  3. c. Film critics praised the innovative visuals when the indie project debuted at an international festival.
  4. d. They spent three years perfecting their computer animation to create lifelike character expressions.
Câu 5
  1. a. Working under flickering lanterns, the dedicated surgeon saved hundreds of lives with limited supplies.
  2. b. Dr. Alistair volunteered to provide medical care when conflict broke out along the disputed frontier.
  3. c. His selfless courage earned him the highest civilian honor when peace finally returned to the region.
  4. d. He established a makeshift field hospital inside a mountain cavern to shelter the wounded from artillery fire.

Bài #11 DICTIONARY ENTRY 11_dictionary_entry.json

Dictionary Entries

Look at the dictionary entries below. Use the information provided to complete the sentences.

determination
noun /dɪˌtɜːmɪˈneɪʃn/
the ability to continue trying to achieve something difficult despite obstacles
Collocations & Contextual Usages:
  • Her determination to succeed against poverty inspired everyone in the village.
  • In moments of sudden crisis, officers are trained to act with determination.
  • Young athletes frequently show fierce determination during tournament finals.
  • The rescue crew worked throughout the night with unwavering determination.

admire
verb /ədˈmaɪə/
to respect somebody for what they have done or to look at something with pleasure
Collocations & Contextual Usages:
  • Voters continued to admire her for her honesty throughout the political campaign.
  • After working alongside the experienced editor, the intern began to come to admire his patience.
  • Modern architects greatly admire the structural balance of the ancient cathedral.
  • Visitors to the national park can admire from afar the rare migratory birds.

achievement
noun /əˈtʃiːvmənt/
a thing that somebody has done successfully, especially using their own effort and skill
Collocations & Contextual Usages:
  • Completing the difficult mountain trek gave the scouts a deep sense of proud achievement.
  • The scholarship committee evaluates candidates primarily on their high level of academic achievement.
  • Preserving the pristine rainforest will remain the minister's most lasting achievement.
  • The software developers gathered at dinner to celebrate an achievement after launching their platform.
📝 Practice Sentences:

Đáp án: academic achievement
#6

devote
verb /dɪˈvəʊt/
to give an amount of time, attention, or effort to something
Collocations & Contextual Usages:
  • Engineers must devote energy to making renewable solar batteries more efficient.
  • Young volunteers often devote themselves to clearing litter along polluted shorelines.
  • Busy working parents should still devote time to outdoor activities with their children.
  • The remaining museum galleries will be devoted entirely to regional pottery.

#7

Đáp án: devote time to

independent
adjective /ˌɪndɪˈpendənt/
not governed or controlled by other people, countries, or organizations
Collocations & Contextual Usages:
  • After decades under colonial administration, the nation fought to become fully independent.
  • By learning computer programming, teenagers can become financially independent at an early age.
  • The small island territory sought to remain independent from outside political alliances.
  • The philosophy professor was an independent thinker who challenged standard assumptions.

Translation

Translate the following sentences into English, using the vocabulary you have learned.

Câu 1
🇻🇳 Trong khi bác sĩ phẫu thuật đang tiến hành ca mổ khẩn cấp, bệnh viện dã chiến đã bị cúp điện.

While the surgeon was performing an emergency operation, the field hospital lost power.

🇻🇳 Nhà lãnh đạo có tầm nhìn xa trông rộng đã cống hiến cả cuộc đời mình cho nền độc lập của đất nước.
🇬🇧 Đáp án chuẩn:
The visionary leader devoted his whole life to the independence of the nation.
Câu 3
🇻🇳 Cô ấy cảm thấy vui sướng ngất ngây khi bộ phim hoạt hình bom tấn của mình giành giải thưởng quốc tế.
🇬🇧 Đáp án chuẩn:
She felt on top of the world when her animated blockbuster won an international award.
Câu 4
🇻🇳 Nhiều chiến sĩ dũng cảm đã thực hiện các cuộc tấn công bất ngờ trong suốt cuộc kháng chiến.
🇬🇧 Đáp án chuẩn:
Many brave soldiers carried out surprise attacks during the resistance war.
Câu 5
🇻🇳 Ông bà tôi đã có một cuộc hôn nhân lâu dài và luôn luôn tương trợ lẫn nhau.
🇬🇧 Đáp án chuẩn:
My grandparents had a long marriage and always supported each other.
Câu 6
🇻🇳 Nhà sản xuất phim đã quyết định bỏ học đại học để theo đuổi niềm đam mê điện ảnh của mình.
🇬🇧 Đáp án chuẩn:
The film producer decided to drop out of college to pursue his passion for cinema.
Câu 7
🇻🇳 Khi người anh hùng dân tộc qua đời, hàng triệu người dân đã chia sẻ những lời triân chân thành.
🇬🇧 Đáp án chuẩn:
When the national hero passed away, millions of citizens shared heartfelt tributes.
Câu 8
🇻🇳 Vị thiên tài quân sự đã thay đổi chiến thuật chiến đấu trong khi quân địch đang tiến công.
🇬🇧 Đáp án chuẩn:
The military genius changed his battle tactics while the enemy troops were advancing.
Câu 9
🇻🇳 Hai sinh viên đã trở nên thân thiết nhờ sở thích chung về kỹ xảo hoạt họa máy tính khi còn học ở trường.
🇬🇧 Đáp án chuẩn:
Two students bonded over their shared interest in computer animation while they were attending school.
Câu 10
🇻🇳 Tôi đang đọc một cuốn tiểu sử truyền cảm hứng thì bạn tôi gọi điện rủ đi công viên giải trí.
🇬🇧 Đáp án chuẩn:
I was reading an inspiring biography when my friend called to invite me to the theme park.

Living in a (1) multicultural city offers wonderful opportunities to discover diverse global heritages. A cherished local (3) custom encourages families from every background to share authentic dishes representing their homeland. Attending these public gatherings teaches high school students to (7) appreciate the cultural richness of their community. Before returning home, many visitors purchase an artisan (8) souvenir from the craft stalls as a lasting memento. The vibrant weekend concludes with an energetic street (9) carnival where dancers in flamboyant feather headdresses parade past cheering crowds. Preserving this communal celebration ensures that our proud cultural (10) tradition remains strong for generations to come.
Bài #8 SENTENCE ORDERING MULTIPLE CHOICE 08_sentence_ordering.json

Put the sentences in the correct order

Read the sentences and choose the correct order to form a logical paragraph or conversation.

Câu 1
  1. a. City residents can explore authentic international dishes and celebrate world festivals without traveling abroad.
  2. b. Many modern metropolitan areas across the globe are home to residents from diverse ethnic backgrounds.
  3. c. Living in such an environment helps individuals develop greater cultural empathy and global awareness.
  4. d. This widespread diversity enriches urban life by introducing different artistic traditions, languages, and culinary practices.
Câu 2
  1. a. Anna: 'Yes, our committee agreed to showcase spring rolls and grilled lemongrass pork.'
  2. b. Anna: 'Don't worry, my parents offered to buy the fresh herbs and rice paper from the morning market.'
  3. c. Nam: 'Are we still setting up an international food stall for next week's school festival?'
  4. d. Nam: 'That sounds delicious, but will we have enough ingredients to serve all the visitors?'
Câu 3
  1. a. These young apprentices gradually master the ancestral patterns and glaze recipes passed down through generations.
  2. b. Local artisans patiently teach their children the delicate technique of shaping clay on revolving wooden wheels.
  3. c. Their dedication ensures that the cherished family craft continues to thrive in an era of mass production.
  4. d. Handcrafted ceramic making has been preserved in this riverside village for over three centuries.
Câu 4
  1. a. Alex: 'How did you manage to overcome culture shock when you first studied abroad in London?'
  2. b. Huy: 'I made local friends through the campus badminton club, which helped me understand daily cultural norms.'
  3. c. Huy: 'At first, I felt overwhelmed by the fast pace and unfamiliar commuting habits.'
  4. d. Alex: 'Did you find any effective strategies to feel more comfortable in that new environment?'
Câu 5
  1. a. Today, the festival has evolved into a global commercial celebration centered around trick-or-treating and creative disguises.
  2. b. Over time, European emigrants carried these seasonal customs across the Atlantic to North America.
  3. c. People believed that protective bonfires and costumes would ward off roaming spirits during the dark winter transition.
  4. d. The origins of Halloween date back more than two thousand years to an ancient Celtic harvest celebration.

Base Word Verb Noun Adjective Adverb

tradition (noun) — tradition traditional traditionally

Bài #8 SENTENCE ORDERING MULTIPLE CHOICE 08_sentence_ordering.json

Put the sentences in the correct order

Read the sentences and choose the correct order to form a logical paragraph or conversation.

Câu 1
  1. a. These panels generate abundant electricity, which directly reduces our dependency on fossil fuel generators.
  2. b. This green energy system will save public funds and cut urban greenhouse emissions significantly.
  3. c. Our town council approved the installation of high-efficiency solar panel arrays across municipal rooftops.
  4. d. The clean power collected during daylight hours is subsequently stored in modern neighbourhood batteries.
Câu 2
  1. a. Huy: 'Great idea! What organic materials should we layer into the wooden bin first?'
  2. b. Huy: 'Where should we build our new compost pile in the school garden?'
  3. c. Mai: 'We can begin with dry brown twigs and fallen leaves before adding vegetable kitchen scraps.'
  4. d. Mai: 'Near the tool shed under the shady tree would be an ideal spot.'
Câu 3
  1. a. Ingesting non-biodegradable debris damages their digestive systems and can fatally harm wild animals.
  2. b. Marine turtles and seabirds frequently mistake these buoyant plastic fragments for natural food.
  3. c. Strictly enforcing package recycling and banning throwaway cutlery can stop this ecological tragedy.
  4. d. Millions of single-use takeaway food containers and plastic bottles enter marine environments every year.
Câu 4
  1. a. Lan: 'I noticed some students leave the bathroom taps running while washing their hands.'
  2. b. Lan: 'Do you think our principal will agree to replace them with automatic sensor taps?'
  3. c. Minh: 'Definitely, because modern sensor taps cut water wastage immediately and pay for themselves.'
  4. d. Minh: 'That is such a terrible waste of water when resources are so precious.'
Câu 5
  1. a. The collected biogas is then converted into electricity to power local public transport.
  2. b. Trapped deep under soil layers, decomposing food waste produces large volumes of combustible methane.
  3. c. Urban landfills receive thousands of tons of unsorted municipal garbage each week.
  4. d. Modern waste facilities install specialized subterranean piping systems to capture this toxic gas.

Bài #11 DICTIONARY ENTRY 11_dictionary_entry.json

Dictionary Entries

Look at the dictionary entries below. Use the information provided to complete the sentences.

pollutant
noun /pəˈluːtənt/
a substance that makes air, water, or soil dirty and not suitable or safe to use
Collocations & Contextual Usages:
  • Environmental scientists identified plastic microfibers as a major pollutant threatening coastal wildlife.
  • Heavy vehicle exhaust is recognized as a common air pollutant in crowded downtown streets.
  • Old thermal power stations can release a pollutant into nearby freshwater reservoirs.
  • The agricultural inspection team detected a dangerous chemical pollutant in the farmland drainage canal.
📝 Practice Sentences:
#1

Đáp án: air pollutant
#2
Strict environmental laws prevent manufacturing factories from having the right to into public streams.
Đáp án: release a pollutant
decompose
verb /ˌdiːkəmˈpəʊz/
to break down gradually into smaller parts through natural, chemical, or biological processes
Collocations & Contextual Usages:
  • Beneficial soil microbes and earthworms help decompose organic matter into nutrient-rich humus.
  • Thick cardboard packaging takes several humid months to decompose slowly in a backyard garden.
  • Most cotton canvas fabrics can decompose over time without leaving synthetic toxic residues behind.
  • Fruit peelings and dry garden leaves will decompose naturally when buried in aerated soil.
📝 Practice Sentences:
#3
Adding red wriggler worms to your compost barrel will much faster than ordinary aeration alone.
Đáp án: help decompose organic matter
#4
Dense wooden tree bark requires many rainy seasons beneath the forest floor before turning into rich loam.
Đáp án: to decompose slowly
sustainable
adjective /səˈsteɪnəbl/
able to continue or be continued for a long time without damaging the environment
Collocations & Contextual Usages:
  • Switching municipal bus fleets entirely to electricity is economically sustainable over a ten-year operational period.
  • Crop rotation and drip irrigation are traditional techniques supporting sustainable agriculture in rural valleys.
  • Local timber companies are legally required to manage forestry reserves in a sustainable manner without clear-cutting.
  • Biodegradable seaweed wraps offer an innovative, sustainable alternative to plastics for packaging fresh groceries.
📝 Practice Sentences:
#5
Natural bamboo cutlery provides a durable, when packing takeaway lunches.
Đáp án: sustainable alternative to plastics
#6
Farmers adopting organic fertilisation and solar water pumps contribute greatly to across the countryside.
Đáp án: sustainable agriculture
container
noun /kənˈteɪnə/
an object such as a box, bottle, or jar that can be used for holding something
Collocations & Contextual Usages:
  • Mai washed an aluminium container for food leftovers before putting it in her school backpack.
  • Customers who purchase package-free detergents must use a container brought from home.
  • Keep dried pantry herbs and spices in a labelled storage container to prevent moisture damage.
  • Laboratory researchers placed biological specimens inside a firmly sealed glass container on the sterilised bench.
📝 Practice Sentences:
#7

Đáp án: use a container
#8
To preserve homemade raspberry jam without spoiling, pour the warm mixture into a .
Đáp án: sealed glass container
refill
verb /ˌriːˈfɪl/
to fill something again after it has been emptied or partly emptied
Collocations & Contextual Usages:
  • Modern airport transit lounges provide filtered water stations so passengers can easily refill bottles before flying.
  • If your metal flasks are empty, you can refill them at the hallway drinking fountain free of charge.
  • Customers at the neighborhood beverage kiosk are encouraged to refill cups rather than requesting disposable mugs.
  • Athletes at the marathon finish line quickly refill containers with water to rehydrate after running.
📝 Practice Sentences:

Đáp án: refill containers with water
#10

Đáp án: to refill cups

🇬🇧 Đáp án chuẩn:
Single-use plastics take hundreds of years to decompose naturally.

🇬🇧 Đáp án chuẩn:
Many people carry a reusable bottle when going to school.

My family turns food leftovers into compost, which helps reduce household waste.

Green energy from wind and sun helps cut down on carbon dioxide.

Turning off electrical appliances when not in use helps prevent a waste of electricity.

🇬🇧 Đáp án chuẩn:
Students use public transport to reduce their carbon footprint.
